<CLT=cltMIND>As I walked in, I noticed the moving bookcase
at the end of the room was slowly closing.
<CLT=cltMIND>But there was no sign of the mastermind.

<CLT=cltMIND>The moving bookcase had closed on its own,
without any outside help.

<CLT=cltMIND>We quickly walked toward the moving
bookcase.

<CLT=cltMIND>And then, not too far from the moving
bookcase...we saw...
